questions.question: The smallest blood vessels which are one-cell thick, are called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Capillaries.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• The smallest blood vessels which are one cell thick, are called Capillaries.
 
• Their main function is to enable the exchange of substances between the blood and surrounding tissues.
 
• They provide nutrients and oxygen to tissues and remove the byproducts of cellular reactions, such as carbon dioxide and water.
 
• The Vena cava is a large vein that returns deoxygenated blood from the body to the heart.
 
• Arteries are the blood vessels that deliver blood from the heart to the body. Veins are blood vessels that carry blood toward the heart.

questions.question: Scientists from China have successfully cloned which animal for the first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Monkey.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 

 
• Zhong Zhong and Hua Hua are a pair of identical crab-eating macaques that were produced by scientists from the Institute of Neuroscience of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Shanghai on 5th Dec 2017.
 
• They were created through somatic cell nuclear transfer.
 
• The same cloning technique that produced Dolly the sheep in 1996,
 
• Scientists from China successfully cloned monkeys for the first time in January 2018.
 
• Two long-tailed, and identical macaques named Hua Hua and Zhong Zhong were born to become the first primates to be cloned from a non-embryonic cell.

questions.question: Limbs of frog, lizard, bird and human are example of ________ organs.
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is__** Homologous.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• Limbs of frogs, lizards, birds and humans are examples of homologous organs.
 
• If the traits of two different organisms have been inherited from common ancestry, then that is known as homology.
 
• Since the arm of a human, the wings of birds and bats, and the forelimbs of frogs and lizards have a common underlying anatomy that they inherited from their last common ancestors, that is why they are known as homologous organs.

questions.question: On what basis Greek thinker Aristotle classified the animals for the first time?
questions.solution:
Greek thinker Aristotle classified animals on the basis of Habitat.

**__EXPLANATION:__**

 
• Aristotle classified animals according to whether they lived in water, on land, or in the air.
 
• Aristotle (384-322 BC) was an ancient Greek philosopher and scientist.
 
• He was born in the city of Stagira, Chalkidiki, in the north of Classical Greece.
 
• Along with Plato, he is considered the "Father of Western Philosophy".

questions.question: In honey bees, _____

options.text: males are diploid and females are haploid.
males are triploid and females are tetraploid.
males are haploid and females are diploid.
males are tetraploid and females are triploid.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**males are haploid and females are diploid**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In honey bees, males are haploid and females are diploid.**
 
• **Males (drones)** develop from unfertilized eggs and possess only **one set of chromosomes**.
 
• Females (workers and queens) develop from fertilized eggs and possess two sets of chromosomes.
 
• This is an example of a genetic system known as **haplodiploidy**.
 
• The haplodiploid system determines the sex of the offspring based on the number of chromosome sets they receive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Haplodiploidy** is a common genetic system in several insect orders, including Hymenoptera (bees, ants, and wasps).
 
• In haplodiploid species, the sex determination mechanism can influence social structure and behavior, particularly in eusocial species like honey bees.
 
• **Queens can control the sex of their offspring by choosing whether to fertilize an egg**.
 
• This system allows for a high degree of relatedness among workers, which can promote cooperative behaviors.

questions.question: Identify the INCORRECT statement regarding invertebrates from the options given below.

options.text: They possess a backbone and an internal skeleton.
They have radial or bilateral body symmetry.
They have a pair of solid nerve cords, situated ventrally and bearing segmentally arranged ganglia.
They have open circulatory system as there is no organisation in the distribution.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**They possess a backbone and an internal skeleton**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Invertebrates do not possess a backbone or an internal skeleton.
 
• They exhibit either radial or bilateral body symmetry.
 
• They have a pair of solid nerve cords, situated ventrally and bearing segmentally arranged ganglia.
 
• They typically have an open circulatory system as there is no organization in the distribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Invertebrates constitute a vast majority of animal species on Earth, covering groups such as insects, arachnids, mollusks, crustaceans, and more.
 
• Despite lacking a backbone, many invertebrates have specialized adaptations that allow them to thrive in diverse environments.
 
• The study of invertebrates is crucial for understanding ecological interactions, evolutionary biology, and the development of medical and technological innovations.
 
• Invertebrates play key roles in ecosystems, including pollination, decomposition, and serving as food for other animals.

questions.question: Features and habits that help animals to adapt to their surroundings are a result of the process of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Evolution__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Evolution: It can be defined as a naturally occurring slow, continuous and irreversible process of change. It is the gradual change of living organisms from pre-existing organisms since the beginning of life into various other forms. 

Explanation:__

The modern system of classification of living beings is based on the principles of __evolution (homology). __

 
• Earlier scientists classified organisms on the basis of their habitat (ecology) into aquatic, and terrestrial. 
 
• Then, Aristotle classified plants into herbs, shrubs, and trees according to their heights or their external appearance i.e. morphology.
 
• Then, anatomy or internal structure was emphasized for classifying organisms, such as cell structure, number of cells, components of the cell wall, etc. 
 
• With advancements in technology, scientists are now able to study the evolutionary lineage of different organisms by studying their DNA. 
 
• It has been observed that Birds and Reptiles are made into different categories according to traditional classification systems.
 
• But their evolutionary lineage suggests that they are more closely related to reptiles and they should be in the same group. 
 
• During evolution, new species arose from pre-existing ones.
 
• The accumulation of variations in DNA or genetic material is one of the reasons for evolution. 
 
• Thus, by tracing the similarities in DNA, scientists can tell how closely related two species are, and how they can be classified into different groups.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are CORRECT?

I. Oils containing unsaturated fatty acids should be used for cooking.

II Animal fats have saturated carbon chains.

III. Saturated fatty acids are generally harmful for health
questions.solution: Saturated fats are simply fat molecules that have no double bonds between carbon molecules because they are saturated with hydrogen molecules. Saturated fats are typically solid at room temperature. Some food items that contain saturated fats are fatty beef, pork, lamb etc.

questions.question: Many marine animals use ________ dissolved in sea-water to make their shells.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbonates.**__

**__Explanation:__**

 
• Marine animals use calcium carbonates for making their shells while using the process of Ocean Acidification. Calcium carbonates are found in abundance in seawater.
 
• Animals make hard shells from calcium carbonates. This process is called coastal acidification.
